summary_original: Greetings, MTG Arena players! Since the last State of the Formats article in 2024 , MTG Arena 's formats have continued to evolve. "Explorer" was renamed Pioneer when we achieved parity with competitive tabletop Pioneer. We now have a third distinct Brawl format with its own banned card list and metagame. On the Limited side of things, we now regularly offer five different kinds of drafts with each release, in addition to the always popular, always powerful Arena Powered Cube ! That is a lot of change over a short period of time, so let's break it all down. Before diving in, I have one larger change to announce that will shape the future of formats on MTG Arena . Nekromantka pokleká a položí ruce na jeho tělo. Neexistuje žádná magie. Neexistuje žádná zloba. Vraska vidí slzy na tvářích, sleduje chvění ve rtech. "Je to mnohem víc," říká Liliana příliš tiše na to, aby to byl rozhovor. Vraska si není jistá, co tím myslí... dokud si nevzpomene. Garruk remains far away. She pays them no attention. Her world is in her arms, and it is still warm from life. Vraska allows herself permission to mourn; grief wells up as an endless wave. Then, impossibly, she feels Liliana next to her. The necromancer kneels, laying her hands on his body. There is no magic. There is no malice. Vraska sees tears on her cheeks, watches the tremble in her lips. "It is so much more," Liliana says, too quietly for it to be a conversation. Vraska isn't certain what she means … until she remembers. She remembers what Jace shared of Liliana on that riverbed all those years ago. Will you be sad when I die? How callous she had been in response. Liliana hangs her head close to Jace's chest, unaware that Vraska knows the context. She watches the other woman shake with grief, and Vraska places a hand on her shoulder.

Pokračujeme ve vyšetřování toho, co se dnes stalo, a může chvíli trvat, než si to pořádně rozmyslíme.
